articles.title: World Cup Fans Can't Get Enough of America's Giant Food and Yellow School Buses
articles.summary: A Japanese tourist's post about Texas Roadhouse bread got 200,000 views. World Cup visitors are discovering everyday America—from Buc-ee's to huge portions—and loving it, even as some wonder if the excitement is real.

articles.title: Why Did the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool Turn Green?
articles.summary: The Reflecting Pool in Washington, D.C., turned bright green from algae just weeks after a Trump-ordered paint job. Scientists say the new dark blue bottom and hot weather made it a perfect home for the tiny plants.

articles.title: Did Italy's Leader Really 'Beg' for a Photo? A Big Fight with Trump
articles.summary: Italy's prime minister says Trump made up a story that she begged him for a photo. She fired back in a video, and Italy's foreign minister canceled a U.S. trip. Now the two allies are in a diplomatic spat.
